infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MyMoodMapp uses the microphone to record voice journal entries in your mood logs and for audio playback features in Mood Lab.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: MyMoodMapp saves your AI-generated mood art and vibe cards to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: MyMoodMapp reads your health data including steps, sleep, and heart rate to correlate with your mood patterns.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: MyMoodMapp may write mood-related wellness summaries to Apple Health so your data stays in sync across your health apps.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MyMoodMapp uses your approximate location to show local weather and correlate it with your mood.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MyMoodMapp uses the camera to capture photos for your mood journal entries.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MyMoodMapp can save your mood art to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: MyMoodMapp uses your contacts to invite friends as Accountability Buddies to help you stay consistent with your daily mood logging.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: MyMoodMapp can add mood check-in reminders to your calendar to help you build a consistent daily logging habit.
